description: Claude Code prompts by permission mode and the transitions between modes, from OTel log events.

links.title: Claude Working Time
links.tooltip: How long Claude Code worked for each engineer, per repository and workday. That dashboard uses your browser's timezone where this one uses UTC, so a relative range such as Today covers your local day there

panels.description: The permission mode used by the most prompts in the selected time range, projects, engineers and repositories. 'Agentic' is Claude Code's default mode. Counts every prompt, including ones that made no model request.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE m.mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE m.mode END AS "Most used mode"
FROM (
  SELECT p.permission_mode AS mode, COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY p.permission_mode
) m
ORDER BY m.prompts DESC, m.mode
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Most Used Mode

panels.description: The reasoning effort used by the most prompts in the selected time range, projects, engineers and repositories. Only prompts that made at least one model request count; 'N/A' means no effort was reported.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE m.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' WHEN '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(m.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(m.effort, 2)) END AS "Most used effort"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.effort, '') AS effort, COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.api_request_count > 0
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.effort, '')
) m
ORDER BY m.prompts DESC, m.effort
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Bypass Permissions Share

panels.description: Percentage of sessions with at least one prompt in the selected filters that also switched permission mode at least once in the time range. The mode a session starts in does not count as a switch.

targets.rawSql:
-- switched holds the sessions with at least one switch in the time range.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id), 0) AS "Sessions with a switch"
FROM ai_prompts p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.session_id
  FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
    AND m.from_mode <> ''
) s ON s.session_id = p.session_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Engineers Using Plan Mode

panels.description: Prompts, share of prompts, total cost, and cost, tokens and tool calls per prompt, for each permission mode, model (or model combination), effort, repository and engineer. Prompts that made no model request, such as local slash commands, are left out, so Share is out of the remaining prompts. Repository 'Unknown' / Project 'No repository' means the prompt ran outside a repository; 'Unmapped' means no DevLake project you can access collects that repository.

targets.rawSql:
-- r groups every prompt the panel counts on the raw columns; the labels are applied once per row.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.repository_url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
    -- another account with the same email.
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    p.permission_mode, p.models_used, p.effort,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(p.input_tokens + p.output_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens,
    SUM(p.tool_call_count) AS tool_calls
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
  GROUP BY p.repository_url, 2, p.permission_mode, p.models_used, p.effort
)
SELECT CASE r.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE r.permission_mode END AS "Mode",
  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') AS "Model",
  CASE r.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(r.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(r.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS "Effort",
  CASE
    WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', '')
    -- CodeCommit URLs have no owner, only v1/repos/ before the repository name.
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/v1/repos/', '')
    -- Azure DevOps puts _git/ between the project and the repository.
    ELSE REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', ''), '/_git/', '/')
  END AS "Repository",
  CASE
    WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitHub'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitLab'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'Bitbucket'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(dev[.]azure[.]com|[^/]+[.]visualstudio[.]com)/' THEN 'Azure DevOps'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN 'AWS CodeCommit'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://source[.]developers[.]google[.]com/' THEN 'Google Cloud Source'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?codeberg[.]org/' THEN 'Codeberg'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git[.]sr[.]ht/' THEN 'SourceHut'
    -- Any other host, such as a self-hosted Gitea, is shown by its host name.
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://([^/]+).*$', '$1')
  END AS "Repo Source",
  CASE WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'No repository' ELSE COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') END AS "Project",
  COALESCE(r.full_name, r.user) AS "Engineer",
  r.prompts AS "Prompts",
  r.prompts / SUM(r.prompts) OVER () AS "Share",
  r.cost AS "Cost",
  r.cost / r.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  r.tokens / r.prompts AS "Tokens per prompt",
  r.tool_calls / r.prompts AS "Tool calls per prompt",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(r.repository_url, '') AS repository_link
FROM r
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url drops one trailing / and then one .git suffix, and is lowercased, so normalize
  -- repos.url the same way.
  SELECT LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', '')) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  -- Only projects the viewer can access, so a repository shared with another project doesn't
  -- reveal its name.
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
    AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_p.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_p WHERE upm_p.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', ''))
) dl ON dl.url = r.repository_url
ORDER BY 1, r.repository_url IS NULL, 5, 4, 7, r.prompts DESC

panels.title: Permission Mode Breakdown

panels.description: Permission mode changes in the time range, counted as changes and distinct sessions, by from mode, to mode, trigger, and the model and effort of the session's latest prompt at the time of the change. '(session start)' is a session's starting mode and '(no prompt)' a change before the session's first prompt. Model 'N/A' means that prompt made no model request (for example /plan); Effort 'N/A' means no effort was reported.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CASE m.from_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE m.from_mode END, ''), '(session start)') AS "From",
  CASE m.to_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE m.to_mode END AS "To",
  CASE WHEN pr.models_used IS NULL THEN '(no prompt)' WHEN pr.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(pr.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS "Model",
  CASE pr.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(pr.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(pr.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS "Effort",
  m.`trigger` AS "Trigger",
  COUNT(*) AS "Changes",
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
-- The prompt running when the mode changed: the session's latest prompt started at or before the change.
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p2.models_used, p2.effort
  FROM ai_prompts p2
  WHERE p2.workspace_key = m.workspace_key AND p2.session_id = m.session_id AND p2.started_at <= m.changed_at
  ORDER BY p2.started_at DESC, p2.prompt_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) pr ON TRUE
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
  AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring}))
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Mode Transitions

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

    c.team_slug AS __text,

FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))

    c.team_slug AS __text,

FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp

  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))

list.definition:
-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
ORDER BY 1;

list.definition:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;

-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
